"I'm sorry, but we don't have a cask for you," @4 quickly lied. "But if we get to Malac's Cross, we'll be sure and get it for you."
	"Ooah," she squawked, disappointed. "Well, that's a bit of bad luck then." Wiping her hands on the front of her dress, she looked back to the interior of the house. "I was a'fixing something for Ulam to eat, so I best get back to it. Good day to you then, gents."�
entries.translation:
「抱歉，我們沒帶你的木桶，」@4連忙撒了個謊。「不過要是我們去了馬拉克十字鎮，一定會幫你帶回來的。」
	「唉呀，」她失望地叫了一聲。「那真是不走運了。」她在裙子前擦了擦手，回頭望向屋內。「我正在幫烏蘭弄點吃的，還是先進去忙吧。兩位，日安了。」�

entries.source:
Petrumh opened the door.
	Surprisingly alert for an elderly lady who had made a trek from Malac's Cross to Darkmoor unescorted, she greeted them with a broken toothed smile and motioned for them to come in. Shaking his head, @4 remained rooted in the doorway.
	"Sorry, we don't really have the time to come in," he apologized. "We just wanted to check in and see that you made your trip safely."
	"Oh, aye," she replied in her thick burr. "That I did. And what of you fellows? Did you by chance get back me cask I left at the Queen's Row?"
	"We haven't been into Malac's Cross as yet," @4 replied. "But if we get there, we'll be sure and get it for you."
	"Ooah," she squawked, disappointed. "Well, that's a bit of bad luck then." Wiping her hands on the front of her dress, she looked back to the interior of the house. "I was a'fixing something for Ulam to eat, so I best get back to it. Good day to you then, gents."�
entries.translation:
佩特魯姆開了門。
	這位獨自從馬拉克十字鎮徒步跋涉到黑沼鎮的老婦人，精神好得出乎意料，她露出缺了牙的笑容招呼他們，示意請他們進屋。@4搖了搖頭，仍站在門口沒動。
	「抱歉，我們其實沒什麼時間進去坐，」他致歉道。「我們只是想順道來看看，確認你一路平安到家了。」
	「哦，是啊，」她用濃重的鄉音回答道。「是平安到家了。那你們幾位呢？有沒有順道幫我把我留在王后巷旅店的那只木桶帶回來？」
	「我們還沒去過馬拉克十字鎮，」@4回答道。「不過要是我們去了，一定會幫你帶回來的。」
	「唉呀，」她失望地叫了一聲。「那真是不走運了。」她在裙子前擦了擦手，回頭望向屋內。「我正在幫烏蘭弄點吃的，還是先進去忙吧。兩位，日安了。」�

entries.source:
Someone was shouting at them.
	The voice seemed to be coming from the house, but @4 couldn't be sure. He listened intently for a moment and the shouting began again.
	"Ahs jaunt scopions... Stah awah!" cried the voice.
	"What's he saying?" asked @0.
	@4 pursed his lips and shook his head, "I can't tell...his accent sounds Hadati and I can't make it out. Perhaps we should go find out."�
entries.translation:
有人正朝他們大喊。
	那聲音似乎是從屋子裡傳來的，但@4無法確定。他仔細聽了片刻，那喊聲又響了起來。
	「Ahs jaunt scopions... Stah awah!」那聲音喊道。
	「他在說什麼？」@0問道。
	@4抿緊嘴唇，搖了搖頭，「我聽不出來……他的口音聽起來像哈達提人，我聽不懂。或許我們該過去看看是怎麼回事。」�

entries.source:
Ockie was not at home.
	@4 knocked on his door again, but receiving no answer he turned to @0 and said, "He doesn't seem to be about. Let's go."�
entries.translation:
奧奇不在家。
	@4又敲了敲他家的門，卻沒人回應，他轉向@0說道：「他好像不在。我們走吧。」�

entries.source:
Before @4 could knock, a scowling man appeared at the door.
	"Yah shoudn't have come," drawled the man with a heavy Hadati accent. "The dead ones in m'yard were all visitin' too."
	With a look of concern on his face he turned to the man and said, "Maybe you should tell us what's going on..."
	The man sighed. "Alright. Mah name's Ockie. Ah'm a trapper. There's a witch woman livin' southeast of here -- causing all sorts of trouble. Scarin' away animals from mah traps! And when ah went to talk to her about it she cahst a spell on mah house! Giant scahpians appear every --" The man suddenly gasped and slammed the door.
	@0 was mumbling to himself. "Scahpions? Scahpians. SCORPIONS? ...Uh oh."�

Ockie appeared frantic.
	"You've got to do somethin' to help me! Ah'm gonna die in here if ah can't ever leave mah house! That witch woman -- AHH!" Screaming he slammed the door.�
entries.translation:
奧奇看起來驚慌失措。
	「你們得幫俺想想辦法！要是俺出不了家門，俺會死在這裡的！那女巫婆——啊啊！」他尖叫一聲，砰地一聲把門關上了。�

entries.source: @4 sighed heavily. "You know, the last time he did that..." He turned around in time to see several giant scorpions appearing before him.�
entries.translation: @4重重嘆了口氣。「你知道嗎，他上次這麼幹的時候……」他轉過身，正好看見好幾隻巨大的蠍子在他面前現形。�

entries.source:
@4 prepared for battle.
	"These things may have been created with some sort of cantrip, but one thing I ñdo know -- they are not merely illusions!"�
entries.translation:
@4擺出應戰的架勢。
	「這些東西大概是用某種小咒法變出來的，但有一件事我ñ很清楚——牠們絕不只是幻象而已！」�

entries.source:
A female voice suddenly filled @4's mind.
	"Ill has be done me, and I shall not speak until the wrong has been erased."
	As quickly as it came, the voice was gone. Shaking his head to empty the intruder from his mind -- like salt from a shaker -- he then turned and banged on the door, trying to get a response from the owner.
	Realizing that none was coming he decided they should leave.�
entries.translation:
一個女人的聲音突然充斥了@4的腦海。
	「我曾受過冤屈，除非這份冤屈得以昭雪，否則我不會開口。」
	那聲音來得快，去得也快。他搖了搖頭，想把這個不速之客從腦海裡甩出去——就像抖掉鹽罐裡的鹽粒一樣——接著轉身敲了敲門，想引起屋主的回應。
	發現沒人回應，他決定他們該離開了。�

entries.source:
Wilindi met @4 at the door.
	"I'm so glad to see you again," she said. "How have you been?"
	They talked for a few minutes while she conjured up some tea and biscuits. After roughly half an hour, the tea and biscuits having disappeared as quickly, though not as magically, as they had appeared, @4 decided it was time to leave.�
entries.translation:
薇琳蒂在門口迎接了@4。
	「真高興又見到你了，」她說道。「你過得怎麼樣？」
	他們聊了幾分鐘，她一邊變出了茶水與餅乾。過了大約半個鐘頭，茶水與餅乾消失的速度跟出現時一樣快，只是少了那份魔法，@4覺得該離開了。�

entries.source:
A wrinkled woman answered @4's knock.
	"I see in your mind that you have righted the wrong that had been done to me," she said. She thanked them, introduced herself as Wilindi, then sighed.
	"People did not understand my magical talents so I moved to the Dimwood to live out my final days in restful solitude. I just wanted to be left alone."
	Believing the old woman's story, @4 said gently, "I'm afraid your hadati neighbor down the way believed you responsible for his trapping miseries."
	The woman looked glum. "Such a simple man. Men like that often fear what they do not understand. I suppose I should've been more tolerant but when he killed some of my livestock and poisoned my well, I'm afraid I lost my temper and called forth the Scorpions to stalk his house. I didn't mean for anyone else to get hurt."
	@4 nodded.
	"Here, sirs. For all your troubles I'd like you to have these things." She reached into the air twice and produced two vials of Lewton's Concentrate.
	@4 took them graciously and thanked her as he headed for the door.�
entries.translation:
一個滿臉皺紋的婦人應了@4的敲門聲。
	「我從你的心思裡看出來了，你已經為我平反了那樁冤屈，」她說道。她謝過他們，自我介紹說自己叫薇琳蒂，接著嘆了口氣。
	「人們不理解我的魔法天賦，所以我搬到了幽暗林，想在寧靜的獨居生活中度過餘生。我只是想一個人清靜清靜。」
	相信了這位老婦人的說詞，@4溫和地說道：「恐怕你那位哈達提鄰居一直以為，是你害他捕獵不順的。」
	那婦人神情黯然。「這人也真是簡單。像他這種人，往往害怕自己不理解的事物。我大概該對他多點寬容，但當他殺了我幾隻牲畜、還在我的井裡下毒之後，恐怕我就氣得失去理智了，於是召來了那些蠍子去騷擾他家。我原本沒打算傷害其他任何人的。」
	@4點了點頭。
	「拿去吧，兩位先生。為了答謝你們遭遇的這番波折，我想送你們這些東西。」她朝空中伸手兩次，變出了兩瓶魯頓濃縮液。
	@4心懷感激地收下了，一邊道謝一邊朝門口走去。�

entries.source:
The well looked inviting.
	Weeds grew around the base of the well in a tangled clump, a good indication it hadn't dried up.�
entries.translation:
這口井看起來很誘人。
	井邊的雜草纏繞叢生，是個不錯的跡象，表示這口井應該還沒乾涸。�

entries.source: "My throat has grown quite parched and my water pouch is nearly empty. Shall we get a drink?"�
entries.translation: 「我喉嚨渴得要命，水袋也快空了。要不要打點水來喝？」�

entries.source: "WAIT! Something... Ishap, we should've been more cautious. There is something in that well besides water. I think it's been poisoned!"�
entries.translation: 「等等！有什麼……伊夏神在上，我們早該小心點的。這口井裡除了水，還有別的東西。我想它被下毒了！」�

entries.source: "Are you sure? Why would someone want to poison their own well? Unless..."�
entries.translation: 「你確定嗎？誰會想毒害自己家的井？除非……」�

entries.source: "...unless someone is trying to poison the ñowner of this well."�
entries.translation: 「……除非有人想毒害這口井的ñ主人。」�

entries.source:
@4 stared at the bucket.
	Moving out of the way, he tipped it over, spilling the poisonous contents to the ground, then watched the water as it trailed down the side of a small hill in tiny rivers, forming tributaries and islets in the dust.
	A discouraged look set upon his face like a dark shadow, but then it just as quickly lifted. He tipped up the bucket and began to fish around inside. When he at last removed his hand he held a small red berry between his thumb and forefinger.
	"Silverthorn," he said.�
entries.translation:
@4盯著水桶。
	他挪到一旁，把桶子一傾，讓那些帶毒的東西灑落到地上，隨後看著那些水沿著小丘的側面流成一道道細流，在塵土間分出一條條支流與小島。
	一抹沮喪的神色像片烏雲籠罩上他的臉，但很快便一掃而空。他把水桶倒過來，在裡頭摸索了一陣。等他終於抽回手時，拇指與食指間夾著一顆小小的紅色漿果。
	「銀刺，」他說道。�

entries.source:
The Silverthorn anti-venom sparkled.
	Moving quickly, @4 poured a few drops of the precious liquid into the well. Then, after a moment's hesitation, he turned the vial upside down, spilling all the contents into the darkness of the watery hole.�
entries.translation:
那瓶銀刺解毒劑閃閃發光。
	@4動作迅速，把幾滴珍貴的液體倒進了井裡。片刻猶豫後，他把整瓶藥水倒了個底朝天，將剩餘的內容物全數灑進了那口幽暗的水井之中。�

entries.source: Let's hope that works. I pray to Ishap the water in this well hasn't already claimed the lives of the owners. I suspect they will be pretty grateful for what we've just done.�
entries.translation: 希望這招管用。我向伊夏神祈禱，這口井裡的水還沒奪走屋主的性命。我猜他們一定會很感激我們剛才做的這件事。�

entries.source:
@4 opened the door.
	"Let's see if there is anything else here we can use that we didn't grab on our last visit," he said.�
entries.translation:
@4打開了門。
	「來看看這裡還有沒有什麼我們上次沒拿到、用得上的東西，」他說道。�

entries.source:
A wrinkled hand pulled open the door.
	"Yes?" croaked a little man, his frail voice cracking with age.
	@4 smiled, "We don't mean to bother you, sir. What news have you of the area?"
	The old man dropped his head, and tears welled up in his eyes as he spoke. "Do not be deceived by what you see. The man before you is well less than half his apparent years."
	"If what you say is true, how could this thing have happened?" asked @0.
	"It is true indeed. I was trapping east of here -- had stayed about a month -- when I suddenly found myself growing weaker by the day. I decided to return home and during this journey I spotted a black robed man with a snake-like face."
	"You think ñhe is the source of your problems?" questioned @4.
	The man sighed. "I wish I knew. But now what am I to do? How shall I eat? I left behind my only ironjaw trap. I would be ever so grateful to have it returned. You shouldn't be affected if you don't stay long."
	With a concerned look @4 turned to @0, then faced the man again, "We will see what we can do," he said.�
entries.translation:
一隻佈滿皺紋的手推開了門。
	「有事嗎？」一個矮小的男人啞聲說道，那虛弱的嗓音因年邁而顫抖著。
	@4微笑道：「我們不是有意打擾您的，先生。這一帶最近有什麼消息嗎？」
	那老人垂下了頭，說話時眼眶泛起了淚水。「別被你們看到的表象給騙了。站在你們面前這個人，實際年齡連看起來的一半都不到。」
	「要是你說的是真的，這事是怎麼發生的？」@0問道。
	「這是千真萬確的。俺原本在這裡以東的地方設陷阱捕獵——待了大約一個月——後來忽然發現自己一天比一天虛弱。俺決定回家，就在回程路上，看見了一個黑袍男子，臉像蛇一樣。」
	「你認為ñ他就是害你變成這樣的元兇？」@4追問道。
	那男人嘆了口氣。「俺倒希望俺知道。可現在俺該怎麼辦？俺要怎麼吃飯？俺把唯一的鐵顎陷阱落在了那裡。要是能幫俺找回來，俺會非常感激的。你們只要別待太久，應該不會受影響。」
	@4神情擔憂地看了看@0，接著再度轉向那男人，「我們會盡力想想辦法，」他說。�

entries.source:
The old man answered after the fourth knock.
	"Have you brought my ironjaw trap?" he asked hopefully.
	@4 shook his head, "We've come to talk to you."
	"I don't want to ñtalkð," he whined. "I'm very very tired. I just want to sleep. My trap is several virgates to the East in an unlocked box. Return when you've found it and we'll talk." He disappeared into his house and closed the door.�
entries.translation:
敲了第四次門後，那老人才應了門。
	「你們把俺的鐵顎陷阱帶來了嗎？」他滿懷希望地問道。
	@4搖了搖頭，「我們是來跟你聊聊的。」
	「俺不想ñ聊天ð，」他嗚咽著說道。「俺累得很，累得很。俺只想睡覺。俺的陷阱在東邊幾維爾格外的一個沒上鎖的箱子裡。找到了再回來，俺們再聊。」他隨即消失進了屋內，關上了門。�

entries.source:
@4 knocked on the door and waited for a reply.
	After nearly a minute, the door cracked open, a gnarled hand finishing the task. "Have you brought my ironjaw trap?" asked the old man in the doorway.�
entries.translation:
@4敲了敲門，等著回應。
	將近一分鐘後，門打開了一條縫，一隻佈滿老繭的手完成了這個動作。「你們把俺的鐵顎陷阱帶來了嗎？」門口那老人問道。�

entries.source:
@4 nodded.
	"We have," he said, producing the trap.
	"Bless you, sirs," wheezed the man. "I hadn't the strength to retrieve it myself. And without it I would sure die of starvation."
	Trap in hand, the man went back inside his house. He returned a moment later with a something clutched in his fist. "This is for you."
	He dropped a golden ring onto @4's upturned palm, then snuck back into the house, closing the door behind him.�
entries.translation:
@4點了點頭。
	「帶來了，」他說著，取出了那個陷阱。
	「兩位先生，願神保佑你們，」那男人喘著氣說道。「俺自己是沒力氣去把它拿回來的。要是沒了它，俺肯定會活活餓死的。」
	拿著陷阱，那男人回到了屋裡。片刻後他又出來了，拳頭裡緊緊攥著什麼東西。「這個給你們。」
	他把一枚金戒指丟進了@4攤開的手掌心，隨後便悄悄溜回屋裡，關上了門。�

entries.source:
The tavern was locked tight.
	"The sign says this place is called the 'Fife and Laurel,'" said @4.
	A man in dark colored clothes suddenly appeared behind them. "The Fife and Laurel is ñclosedð," he hissed. "It has been closed since the destruction of Sethanon. If you are looking for something to eat, there is good trapping to the southeast."
	Before they could say another word, the man had slipped away.�
entries.translation:
這間酒館鎖得死死的。
	「招牌上寫著，這地方叫『笛與月桂』，」@4說道。
	一個身穿深色衣服的男人忽然出現在他們身後。「笛與月桂早就ñ關門了ð，」他嘶聲說道。「自從賽瑟儂被毀之後就一直關著。要是你們是想找點吃的，東南邊有不錯的獵場。」
	他們還沒來得及再問什麼，那男人便已悄然離去。�

entries.source:
@3 stumbled.
	He fell to one knee as a wave of nausea swept the length of his body. His head still swimming, he climbed slowly to his feet, then turned to the others...�
entries.translation:
@3踉蹌了一下。
	一陣噁心感席捲全身，他單膝跪地。頭仍暈眩不已，他緩緩爬起身，轉向其他人……�

entries.source: "There is something... very strange.. about this place. For a moment I felt as though a... great force was reaching up through the ground and sapping my strength."�
entries.translation: 「這地方……有種說不出的詭異。有那麼一瞬間，我感覺像是有股……強大的力量從地底竄了上來，正在吸乾我的力氣。」�

entries.source: "I felt something as well. Perhaps we should turn back until we can discover the cause."�
entries.translation: 「我也感覺到了些什麼。或許我們該先退回去，等查清楚原因再說。」�

entries.source: "I felt something as well. It must be the strange force that Craig spoke of when we spoke to him. Perhaps we should turn back until we can discover the cause. "�
entries.translation: 「我也感覺到了些什麼。一定就是克雷格跟我們提過的那股詭異力量。或許我們該先退回去，等查清楚原因再說。」�

entries.source:
The puzzle worried him.
	Though they had escaped alive, he still was bothered by the presence of the Pantathians in the area. He had no liking for the serpent folk, and their presence in the Kingdom so near the battle sight of Sethanon unnerved @5 a good deal.�
entries.translation:
這個謎團讓他很是煩心。
	雖然他們已經活著逃了出來，但潘塔西亞人出現在這一帶這件事，依然讓他耿耿於懷。他向來對這群蛇人一族沒什麼好感，而他們竟然出現在王國境內、離賽瑟儂的戰場如此之近，這讓@5心裡十分不安。�

entries.source: "What do you think the Pantathians were after, @3? Do you think they were rooting around looking for something?"�
entries.translation: 「你覺得潘塔西亞人到底在打什麼主意，@3？你覺得他們是在到處翻找什麼東西嗎？」�

entries.source: "With the Pantathians, who can tell? No one in the Kingdom knows exactly what they want, but they seem to get mixed up in nearly everything that's got a bad ending. My guess is that they were trying to channel the strength they were stealing into something else. Maybe they needed power for a spell."�
entries.translation: 「潘塔西亞人的事，誰說得準？王國裡沒人真正清楚他們想要什麼，但幾乎每件不得善終的事，多少都能扯上他們。我猜，他們是想把偷來的力量引導到別的東西上。也許是為了某個法術需要力量。」�

entries.source: "I am none to comfortable with the thought of that. I felt their powers when we entered the area, though I didn't know what is was I perceived."�
entries.translation: 「一想到這個我就渾身不自在。我們進入這一帶時，我確實感受到了他們的力量，只是當時不知道自己感受到的是什麼。」�

entries.source: "At least we have come out of there none the worse for the wear. I imagine that Craig is beyond help. It is a good thing we didn't remain a month, as he did."�
entries.translation: 「至少我們毫髮無傷地離開了那裡。我猜克雷格是沒救了。還好我們沒像他那樣在那裡待上一整個月。」�

entries.source: "Well, I don't know about you, but I feel almost normal again. I for one am glad the whole affair is over."�
entries.translation: 「這個嘛，我不知道你們怎麼樣，但我感覺自己幾乎快恢復正常了。我個人是很高興這整件事終於結束了。」�

entries.source:
@4 struggled.
	The ground was well suited for travelling, but ñhe felt less suited to make the journey out of the cove than he did when he entered.�
entries.translation:
@4奮力前行。
	這片地面本該很適合趕路，但ñ他覺得，要走出這片海灣，反倒比進來時還要吃力得多。�

entries.source: I don't feel well.  I don't know what happened to us back there, but I feel as if I've walked a thousand miles today...�
entries.translation: 我覺得不太舒服。我不知道我們剛才在那裡到底遭遇了什麼，但我感覺自己今天好像走了幾千里路一樣……�

entries.source: I can understand a little better how that old fellow Craig said he wasn't half as old as he ñlookedð.  It's as if there were something ófeeding on us back there. It's a good thing we weren't there as long as he was.�
entries.translation: 我現在有點明白，那個叫克雷格的老頭當初說自己實際年齡連ñ看起來ð的一半都不到，是什麼感覺了。就像有什麼東西在那裡ó一直在吸食我們的精氣一樣。還好我們沒像他待得那麼久。�

entries.source:
@4 held the waani in his hand.
	"I pray to Ishap this wooden gem works," he said. "Though I hate to think about the fate of the Kingdom resting on this little experiment, I fear that is the truth of it." He took a deep breath, "Well... shall we give it a try?"�
entries.translation:
@4手裡握著那件瓦阿尼。
	「我向伊夏神祈禱，這件木製法器能派上用場，」他說。「一想到王國的命運竟繫於這麼一個小小的實驗上，我就不太願意細想，但我怕事實正是如此。」他深吸一口氣，「好吧……我們要不要試試看？」�

entries.source:
The waani arced gracefully through the air.
	@4 grunted loudly, nearly falling from the momentum of his throw. He glanced up just in time to see the strange wooden object pass between the two crystal-topped posts.
	The waani never made it to the ground.
	Powerful lightning-like blasts rocketed out from each crystal, ripping it into thousands of tiny fireflies of light that floated gently downward to a cold death on the dusty forest floor. The ground trembled, and before they could utter a sound, an ominous humming buzz rolled towards them. Growing in intensity with each revolution it rose before them striking like a hammer blow, knocking them from their feet in a roaring rush of energy and sound.
	Still dazed, they watched in horror as the energy storm reversed direction. Suddenly it was rushing back through the rift machine, sucking leaves and dirt and small stones with it!�
entries.translation:
那件瓦阿尼在空中劃出一道優美的弧線。
	@4用力一吼，差點被投擲的力道帶得摔倒。他抬頭一看，正好瞥見那件奇特的木製物體穿過了那兩根柱頂鑲著水晶的柱子之間。
	瓦阿尼始終沒有落地。
	強大的閃電般轟擊從兩根水晶柱中猛然噴射而出，把它撕裂成千萬顆微小的光之螢火，緩緩飄落到滿是塵埃的林地上，冷冷地死去。地面震動起來，他們還來不及發出一聲驚呼，一陣不祥的嗡鳴便朝他們滾滾襲來。那嗡鳴隨著每一圈迴旋不斷增強，最終如重錘般擊向他們，一股轟然作響的能量與聲浪把他們掀翻在地。
	他們仍暈眩未定，卻驚恐地看著那股能量風暴逆轉了方向。轉眼間，它便猛然衝回裂界機之中，連帶捲走了樹葉、泥土與碎石！�

entries.source:
The bridge was heavily guarded.
	Several goblins eyed them suspiciously as they approached.
	"Delekhan has sent us to help guard the rift machine," shouted @4 in a gruff voice.
	One of the goblins turned to the others and @4 thought he heard the words "Quegian mercenaries," this was followed by some laughter, which died down almost as quickly as it had begun. "What's the password?" demanded a goblin.�
entries.translation:
這座橋樑戒備森嚴。
	幾隻哥布林狐疑地打量著漸漸靠近的他們。
	「迪勒肯派我們來協助看守裂界機，」@4扯著嗓子粗聲喊道。
	其中一隻哥布林轉向其他同伴，@4似乎聽見了「奎格傭兵」這幾個字，緊接著響起一陣笑聲，但很快就跟起頭時一樣迅速平息下來。「口令是什麼？」一隻哥布林質問道。�

entries.source:
The bridge was heavily guarded.
	Several goblins eyed them suspiciously as they approached.
	"Delekhan has sent us to help guard the rift machine," shouted @4 in a gruff voice.
	One of the goblins turned to the others and @4 thought he heard the words "Quegian mercenaries," this was followed by some laughter, which died down almost as quickly as it had begun. "What's the password?" demanded a goblin.
	@4 stepped forward.
	His stomach in knots he fought desperately to remember the note he'd found in the fairy box...�
entries.translation:
這座橋樑戒備森嚴。
	幾隻哥布林狐疑地打量著漸漸靠近的他們。
	「迪勒肯派我們來協助看守裂界機，」@4扯著嗓子粗聲喊道。
	其中一隻哥布林轉向其他同伴，@4似乎聽見了「奎格傭兵」這幾個字，緊接著響起一陣笑聲，但很快就跟起頭時一樣迅速平息下來。「口令是什麼？」一隻哥布林質問道。
	@4站了出來。
	他胃裡一陣翻攪，拚命回想著他們在精靈寶箱裡找到的那張紙條上寫的內容……�

entries.source: "Perhaps a sharp rap to your skull with the blade of my weapon would help you remember."�
entries.translation: 「或許用我這把武器的劍刃，狠狠敲你的腦袋一下，能幫你想起來。」�

entries.source: "Narab's blood!"�
entries.translation: 「以納拉布之血起誓！」�

entries.source: "Pass quickly men of Queg. The air reeks with your presence."�
entries.translation: 「奎格人，快點通過。空氣裡都是你們的臭味了。」�

entries.source:
The bridge was heavily guarded.
	Several goblins eyed them suspiciously as they approached, their attention split between them and another group of goblins who were sparring halfheartedly nearby.
	"Delekhan sent us to guard the machine," shouted @4 in a gruff voice, remembering his guise as a dull witted mercenary. One of the goblins turned to the others and spat something which @4 assumed to mean "Quegian mercenaries". Immediately laughter sprung up in the goblin ranks, then died down almost as quickly as the leader demanded the password...�
entries.translation:
這座橋樑戒備森嚴。
	幾隻哥布林狐疑地打量著漸漸靠近的他們，注意力在他們與附近另一群心不在焉地互相打鬥的哥布林之間來回切換。
	「迪勒肯派我們來看守這台機器，」@4扯著嗓子粗聲喊道，想起自己扮演的是個腦子不太靈光的傭兵角色。其中一隻哥布林轉向其他同伴，啐了一句什麼，@4猜大概是「奎格傭兵」的意思。哥布林隊伍裡頓時爆出一陣笑聲，隨後也跟起頭時一樣迅速平息，這時首領開口要求對口令……�

entries.source: "The password is same as before. Blood of Narab's "�
entries.translation: 「口令跟上次一樣。以納拉布之血起誓。」�

entries.source: "Pass. But move on before I decide to run you through, Quegian dog!"�
entries.translation: 「通過。但你們最好快點走，免得我改變主意，一劍把你們捅穿，奎格狗！」�

entries.source:
A frightened man answered the door.
	Looking past the man into the open room, @4 could see that he had prepared several bundles, as though he were preparing to leave.
	"I don't have time to talk now," said the man. "I'm leaving and I would urge you to do the same. The goblins and moredhel have moved in... time for me to move out!"
	"Where did you see them?" inquired @0.
	Struggling to stuff a cotton shirt into a large bag, he replied, "They were heading northwest... toward that witch Wilindi's cottage. Wouldn't be surprised if the old crow had something to do with this. Now you'll really have to let me pack. Good day."�
entries.translation:
一個滿臉驚恐的男人應了門。
	越過那男人望向敞開的房間，@4看見他已經打包了好幾個包袱，彷彿正準備離開。
	「俺現在沒空聊，」那男人說道。「俺要走了，俺也勸你們趕緊走。哥布林跟莫瑞德人都搬進來了……俺是時候搬出去了！」
	「你在哪裡看到他們的？」@0追問道。
	那男人正手忙腳亂地想把一件棉衫塞進大袋子裡，回答道：「他們是往西北方去的……朝著那個女巫薇琳蒂的小屋去了。要是那個老巫婆跟這事脫不了關係，俺一點都不意外。現在你們真的得讓俺收拾行李了。日安。」�

entries.source:
They searched the chest.
	"It's not here," exclaimed @4.  "This is the chest Moreaulf told us about, but the Waani isn't here! How will we find it now?"
	"Probably tricked us," Patrus spat. "Can't 'spect a moredhel tell the truth even if'n he's tellin' you how ta kiss his hindquarters!"
	"I don't think that's it," @4 replied. "Perhaps there is something óelse here that can tell us what happened to the Waani..."�
entries.translation:
他們搜遍了整個箱子。
	「不在這裡，」@4驚呼道。「這確實是莫羅爾夫跟我們提過的那個箱子，但瓦阿尼不在裡面！我們現在該怎麼找到它？」
	「多半是被騙了，」派特魯斯啐了一口。「別指望莫瑞德人會說實話，就算他跟你說怎麼親他的屁股，那也是假的！」
	「我倒不這麼認為，」@4回答道。「或許這裡還有ó別的東西，能告訴我們瓦阿尼到底發生了什麼事……」�

entries.source: "I don't know what this Phillip fellow has got up his sleeves, but I intend to find out," @4 said.  "It sounds almost as if he's trying to ólure whoever finds that note north to his home."�
entries.translation: 「我不知道這個叫菲力普的傢伙在打什麼鬼主意，但我打算查個清楚，」@4說道。「聽起來簡直像是他故意想ó引誘發現這張紙條的人往北到他家去。」�

entries.source: "So...nothing ómuch to accomplish. Find something the size of a man in the whole of the Dimwood. Shouldn't be too difficult. "�
entries.translation: 「所以……也沒什麼ó大不了的事要辦嘛。就是在整片幽暗林裡，找出一個人大小的東西而已。應該不會太難的。」�

entries.source: "Not the ómost difficult thing Arutha ever had us do. Remember that berry hunt we went on after the Riftwar? Very nearly wouldn't have found them if we hadn't realized the rainfall had been heavier that year. I'm just sorry we had to drag poor old Patrus along on this one."�
entries.translation: 「這還不是亞魯莎交代過我們最ó困難的事。還記得裂界之戰後我們去找的那批漿果嗎？要不是我們想起那年雨水比較多，差點就找不到了。真是可惜，這一趟還得拖著可憐的老派特魯斯一起來。」�

entries.source: "You worry 'bout your own skins, you whelps. I ken I can run with the best of 'em and you two ain't no exception. Get runny nosed on me and I'll brain the both of you."�
entries.translation: 「你們兩個小毛頭還是先操心自己的小命吧。俺自認跑得比你們這些小夥子都快，你們可比不上俺。誰敢在俺面前擺架子，俺就敲爛你們兩個的腦袋。」�

entries.source: "Better listen to him, Jimmy. He's a killer. "�
entries.translation: 「你最好聽他的話，吉米。他可是個殺手。」�

entries.source: "Umhum. I believe you're right. So, where do you think we should start looking for this rift machine? Your guess would be a good as mine."�
entries.translation: 「嗯哼。我相信你說得對。那，你覺得我們該從哪裡開始找這台裂界機？你猜的跟我猜的差不多準。」�

entries.source: "Since we just came from the north, I'd say it's a good bet it isn't up there anywhere. That still leaves east, west, south and everything in between. Like spearing fish in a barrel. "�
entries.translation: 「既然我們剛從北邊過來，我敢說它大概不會在那個方向。那就還剩東、西、南邊，還有中間各個方向了。簡直像是在木桶裡叉魚一樣容易。」�

entries.source: "That being the case, I suppose we just try to be as systematic as possible. I say we make a sweep east, then maybe move to the south or the west."�
entries.translation: 「既然如此，我看我們就儘量有系統地找吧。我看我們先往東搜一輪，再看看要不要轉往南邊或西邊。」�

entries.source: "East? Why? West seems as good a direction."�
entries.translation: 「東邊？為什麼？西邊感覺也一樣有機會啊。」�

entries.source: "Not sure. But the instinct that's telling me east is the same one that's kept me alive this long, and I've learned not to ignore it. If you've got a better idea, I'll follow your lead..."�
entries.translation: 「說不上來。但告訴我該往東走的這股直覺，正是一直讓我活到現在的同一股直覺，我學會了不要輕易忽視它。要是你有更好的主意，我就聽你的……」�

entries.source:
@4 stopped.
	He looked at the band guarding the pass ahead and called out, "Will you allow us safe passage?"
	An answer was returned swiftly and with great authority, "By the order of Prince Arutha, we forbid you to come any further."
	Cupping a hand to his mouth, @4 called back, "We are on official kingdom business. You must let us pass."
	"We have strict orders not to allow anyone further north," came the response.
	@0 stepped forward and stood next to @4. "What shall we do?"
	"We are greatly outnumbered, we should leave."�

@3 cleared his throat.
	He caught @5's attention, then stopped...�
entries.translation:
@3清了清嗓子。
	他引起了@5的注意，接著便打住了……�

entries.source: "How is it the moredhel have scouts in the Dimwood? And for what purpose?"�
entries.translation: 「莫瑞德人怎麼會派斥候到幽暗林來？目的又是什麼？」�

entries.source: "The moredhel we have seen thus far are all part of Delekhan's war tribe, though I too am puzzled by the number and purpose of these warriors."�
entries.translation: 「到目前為止我們見到的莫瑞德人，全都是迪勒肯部族的人，不過這些戰士的數量與目的，也同樣令我百思不解。」�

entries.source:
@5 stepped up to the leader.
	"We'll kick your behind all the way to the Northlands," he boasted.
	Quickly, @4 stepped forward to confer with @5.  "Have you finally lost what little wits you have?  Are you trying to get us ñkilledð?", he asked. "Besides, this path is leading us ñAWAY from the rift-machine we came to destroy."
	"ñTrust me," assured @5. "I think we can take them."
	As they prepared for battle the Goblin guard called to others hidden in the pass.  @5 shuddered as he saw warriors move from behind the trees, realizing the pass was ñindeed blocked.  "On ñsecond thought, perhaps you ñshouldn't trust me," he said to @4 as they faced the first ranks of the advancing mob.�

@4 scowled.
	"Let's head back," he said. "This way leads out of the Dimwood and óaway from the rift machine. Arutha entrusted us to find and destroy it and I'll be damned first before I let him down on this."�
entries.translation:
@4皺起了眉頭。
	「我們回頭吧，」他說。「這條路只會帶我們離開幽暗林，ó遠離那台裂界機。亞魯莎把找到並摧毀它的任務託付給了我們，我寧死也不會讓他失望。」�

entries.source: "I'm beginning to feel...óstrange. I feel like laying down and taking a nap right here..."�
entries.translation: 「我開始覺得……有點ó怪。我真想就地躺下、打個盹……」�

entries.source: "We must be nearing the sleeping glades that Prince Calin spoke of. I recall he said we should remain close to the mountains once we passed north of a river's fork. We should be able to avoid the effects of the spell if he spoke truly..."�
entries.translation: 「我們一定是快接近凱林親王提過的那片沉睡林間空地了。我記得他說過，一旦我們過了河流分岔口以北，就該盡量靠近山脈行走。要是他說的沒錯，我們應該能避開那個法術的影響……」�

entries.source:
@4 suddenly felt very tired.
	The urge to sleep overwhelmed him, consumed him. He turned to shout a warning, but before a sound could escape his lips his world went dark.
	Nightmare images plagued him, ran through his mind like flames racing to feed on a kerosene soaked rag.
	When he woke the next day, it was with the realization that an entire day had just been stolen from his life. Shaking the the numbness from his limbs he saw @0 doing the same. He picked up his pack and prepared to resume the journey.�
entries.translation:
@4忽然覺得睏意襲來。
	睡意排山倒海而來，將他徹底吞沒。他轉身想喊出警告，但話還沒出口，眼前便已一片漆黑。
	噩夢般的畫面接連折磨著他，像烈焰竄過浸滿煤油的破布般，在他腦海中肆意奔流。
	等他隔天醒來時，才意識到自己的生命裡竟憑空消失了一整天。他甩了甩四肢的麻木感，看見@0也正做著同樣的動作。他拾起背包，準備繼續上路。�

entries.source:
@0 again felt very tired.
	Once again, sleep came quickly...�
entries.translation:
@0再次覺得睏意襲來。
	睡意又一次很快地籠罩了他……�

entries.source:
Gorath motioned for Owyn to join him.
	Staring into the distance, then turning to look the other direction, the moredhel finally began to speak...�
entries.translation:
戈拉斯示意歐文靠過來。
	他先是凝視著遠方，接著又轉頭望向另一邊，這位莫瑞德人終於開口了……�

entries.source: "If the adversaries we've faced are any indication, we can expect hardened opponents as we near Elvandar. Perhaps we should try to find a less combative path."�
entries.translation: 「要是我們目前遭遇的這些敵人能說明什麼，那我們接近艾爾凡達時，只怕會碰上更加難纏的對手。或許我們該試著找一條比較不會遭遇戰鬥的路線。」�

entries.source:
The rusalki was trying to communicate.
	In an odd language they were somehow able to understand, the rusalki spoke to them...�
entries.translation:
那頭露莎卡正試圖與他們交流。
	她用一種奇怪、卻不知怎地能聽懂的語言，向他們開口說話……�

entries.source: "Do not be afraid of me... I can see that your hearts are true and as such I will do you no harm."�
entries.translation: 「不必怕我……我看得出你們的心是真誠的，因此我不會傷害你們。」�

entries.source: "How do you know such things about us?"�
entries.translation: 「你怎麼會知道我們的這些事？」�

entries.source: "I know ñmany things. You are on a quest, are you not?"�
entries.translation: 「我知道的事ñ多著呢。你們是在執行一項使命，是不是？」�

entries.source: "Yes, we are. Can you help us?"�
entries.translation: 「是的，沒錯。你能幫我們嗎？」�

entries.source: "Not directly, no. Only if you would be willing to find the moredhel spellcaster who has been perverting the will's of my kin with a strange device, and retrieve from this man an item stolen from me. He holds an item named after my own person... Eliaem's heart. Return with it, and I will do what I may to assist you."�
entries.translation: 「不能直接幫忙，不行。除非你們願意去找出那個用一件奇怪裝置扭曲我族族人心志的莫瑞德人法師，並從這個人手中取回一件被他偷走的物品。他手上有一件以我本名命名的物品……伊萊安之心。把它帶回來，我便會盡我所能協助你們。」�

entries.source:
The rusalki was trying to communicate.
	In an odd language they were somehow able to understand, the rusalki spoke to them...�
entries.translation:
那頭露莎卡正試圖與他們交流。
	她用一種奇怪、卻不知怎地能聽懂的語言，向他們開口說話……�

entries.source: "You have returned...Have you the artifact of which we spoke?"�
entries.translation: 「你們回來了……你們找到我們說過的那件寶物了嗎？」�

entries.source: "We haven't found the moredhel spellcaster you sent us after..."�
entries.translation: 「我們還沒找到你派我們去找的那位莫瑞德人法師……」�

entries.source: "Westward, at a meeting of the waters. You shall find with him those of my kin whom he has bound to his will. Take care with them, for they shall fight as if you were an enemy born."�
entries.translation: 「往西走，在兩水交會之處。你們會在他身邊找到幾個被他意志所束縛的我的族人。務必小心他們，因為他們會像對待天生的敵人一樣，跟你們拚死一戰。」�

entries.source: "Our thanks. We shall return as fast as we can."�
entries.translation: 「感謝你。我們會盡快趕回來的。」�

entries.source:
@4 stood before the Rusalki.
	"Have you returned with the Eliaems heart?" asked the creature.�
entries.translation:
@4站到了露莎卡面前。
	「你們把伊萊安之心帶回來了嗎？」那生物問道。�

entries.source: "Is the shell valuable?"�
entries.translation: 「這只貝殼很珍貴嗎？」�

entries.source: "In ways you may never fully imagine, but its uses are many. While it bears little on that which you seek, you may yet find another thing you desire."�
entries.translation: 「它的用途，遠比你所能想像的還要多。雖然對你們正在尋找的東西幫助不大，但你們或許還會從中找到另一樣自己渴望的東西。」�

entries.source: "What of Elvandar? Which is the best route there?"�
entries.translation: 「艾爾凡達的事呢？去那裡最好走哪條路？」�

entries.source: "By two roads may you reach the Queen of the Eledhel. If you wander the main roads there are many hazards, but your enemies shall face you. Wander the path less travelled and you may find you face a less substantial opponent. In this, Prince Calin may be of some assistance. Fare well..."�
entries.translation: 「你們可以走兩條路，抵達伊列德人的王后所在之地。走大路的話，沿途危險重重，但你們的敵人也會正面迎戰你們。走人跡罕至的小路，你們遇上的對手可能會沒那麼難纏。這方面，凱林親王或許能幫上一點忙。祝你們一路順風……」�

entries.source: "Perhaps I have misjudged your character. Your heart is as absent in your breasts as the one I seek is missing from mine. Be gone!"�
entries.translation: 「看來我是看錯你們的為人了。你們胸中缺了顆心，正如我尋找的那顆心也已不在我的胸膛裡一樣。走吧！」�

entries.source:
@5 motioned for silence.
	Though it had been years since he had lead his kin through the skirts of the eledhel forest on their escape from the Green Heart, the sights and smells were as familiar to him as the lines on the tips of his fingers. Yet, there was an unnatural ófeeling about the area they stood in...�
entries.translation:
@5示意大家安靜。
	雖然距離他當年領著族人逃離綠心林、穿越伊列德森林邊緣已經過了好些年頭，但眼前的景象與氣味，對他來說依然熟悉得就像自己指尖的紋路一樣。然而，他們此刻所站的這片區域，卻透著一股ó不自然的氣息……�

entries.source: "Something moves nearby, but it is not one of our blood or any forest animal whose movement sounds I know."�
entries.translation: 「附近有東西在移動，但那既不是我們的同族，也不是我所熟悉的任何一種林間動物的動靜聲。」�

entries.source: "I óthought I was hearing something---a high pitched sort of whine. Coming from the south?"�
entries.translation: 「我ó好像聽見了什麼——一種尖銳的嗡鳴聲。是從南邊傳來的嗎？」�

entries.source: "It is the same sound. It might be to our benefit if we were to see what its source is."�
entries.translation: 「是同樣的聲音。要是能查清楚它的來源，或許對我們有好處。」�

entries.source: "What if it's something that thinks we look like dinner?"�
entries.translation: 「要是那東西把我們當成晚餐怎麼辦？」�

entries.source: "If it wish us harm, better that we know what stalks us and have the advantage in attack than to allow it to come and eat us when ñit chooses the moment, don't you think? The choice is yours."�
entries.translation: 「要是它真想傷害我們，與其等它自己ñ挑時機出手，把我們吃掉，倒不如我們先摸清楚是什麼東西在跟蹤我們，搶得先機，你說是不是？這事就交給你決定了。」�

entries.source:
The door was locked.
	"KNEEL BEFORE ME!" commanded a mighty voice that seemed to ring against every wall and corner of the room. The powerful force hit Gorath like a sledgehammer, knocking him to the ground.
	"BRING ME THE KEY OF LINES," a voice commanded. Then it was silent.
	They backed away quietly.�
entries.translation:
這扇門鎖住了。
	「跪下！」一個威嚴的聲音喝道，那聲音彷彿震盪著房間的每一面牆壁、每一個角落。一股強大的力量猛地擊向戈拉斯，像被大鎚重擊一般，把他打倒在地。
	「把線之鑰帶來給我，」一個聲音下令道。隨後便陷入了沉默。
	他們悄悄地退開了。�

entries.source: "Apparently we don't have the key we need. Where in this ñforest are we going to find the right one?"�
entries.translation: 「看來我們手上沒有需要的那把鑰匙。這片ñ森林裡，我們到底要去哪裡找對的那一把？」�

entries.source: "It will be held by one in power for this is a place of ñancient power. I cannot imagine such a loci of the Glamredhel left open for any and all to find. Of all that I know, only three would likely have the way to enter this place and Queen Aglaranna and Warleader Tomas lie at the ñend of our journey. Therefore, our only hope is that we can find Prince Calin. Perhaps he will know."�
entries.translation: 「它會由一位掌權者持有，因為這裡是ñ古老力量匯聚之地。我實在難以想像，格拉姆瑞德人這樣的聖地，會任由任何人隨意闖入尋找。就我所知，全天下大概只有三個人有辦法進入這個地方，而亞葛拉蘭娜王后與戰帥托馬斯，都在我們此行的ñ終點才會遇上。所以，我們唯一的希望，就是找到凱林親王。或許他會知道答案。」�

entries.source:
@4 used the key.
	Opening up the splintered door on rusted hinges, they peered into the darkened shaft that lead into the ancient ruins. Turning to @5, @4 shrugged his shoulders. "So, shall we go in?"�
entries.translation:
@4用了那把鑰匙。
	他們推開了那扇鉸鏈鏽蝕、木板已裂的門，望進了通往這座古老廢墟的幽暗豎坑。轉向@5，@4聳了聳肩。「那，我們要進去嗎？」�

entries.source:
The door was open.
	They entered the cavern and @4 noticed how cool the air felt upon his face. Wishing his clothes were heavier or his skin thicker, he rubbed his elbows as they descended into the ruin.�
entries.translation:
這扇門開著。
	他們進入了洞穴，@4注意到臉上感受到的空氣有多麼涼爽。他真希望自己穿得更厚一點，或者皮膚能再厚實一些，一邊搓著手肘，一邊往這座廢墟深處走去。�

entries.source:
@4 hesitated.
	Shimmering in the hellish alien heat, it seemed probable the sun warmed crystal would blister him if he touched it, but he was curious what material the glass-like pillar had been made of. Privately he wondered if the serpent people they had encountered in the desert plains had been responsible for the enigmatic monoliths, but somehow the idea seemed ñwrong to him...
	ãNãoã.ã ãTãhãeã ãPãiãlãlãaãrãsã ãoãfã ãKãaãrãzãeãeãnã ãwãeãrãeã ãnãoãtã ãcãrãaãfãtãeãdã ãbãyã ãtãhãeã ãPãaãnãaãtãhã-ãTãiãaãnãdãn, a voice whispered in his mind. ãWãeã ãmãaãdãeã ãoãuãrãsãeãlãvãeãsã.ã.ã.
	Horrified by the sudden, uninvited intrusion of the alien presence within his mind, @4 drew back from the column, but the intruder remained. ãWãeã ãsãeãvãeãnã ãwãeãrãeã ãtãhãeã ãgãoãdãsã ãoãfã ãTãiãmãiãrãiãaãnãyãaã,ã ãsãaãvãaãnãiã.ã ãIã ãmãyãsãeãlãfã ãwãaãsã ãoãnãcãeã ãDãhãaãtãsãaãvãaãnã,ã ãLãoãrãdã ãoãfã ãGãaãtãeãsã.ã ãBãuãtã ãoãnãcãeã ãtãhãeã ãVãaãlãhãeãrãuã ãbãrãoãuãgãhãtã ãtãhãeãiãrã ãwãaãrãsã ãoãfã ãdãeãsãoãlãaãtãiãoãnã,ã ãwãeã ãnãaãrãrãoãwãlãyã ãaãvãeãrãtãeãdã ãtãhãeã ãgãrãeãaãtã ãsãtãaãrã ãdãeãaãtãhã.ã.ã.
	"I don't know what any of the things you are saying ómeanð," @4 replied. "I have heard a very little bit about the elven old ones called the Valheru, but beyond that..."
	ãIãtã ãiãsã ãuãnãiãmãpãoãrãtãaãnãtã,ã ãsãaãvãaãnãiã,ã ãtãhãeã ãvãoãiãcãeã ãsãaãiãdã.ã ãWãhãaãtã ãwãeã ãwãeãrãeã ãiãsã ãlãoãsãtã ãbãeãyãoãnãdã ãrãeãgãaãiãnãiãnãgã,ã ãbãuãtã ãtãhãeãrãeã ãiãsã ãtãiãmãeã ãyãeãtã ãtãoã ãsãaãvãeã ãyãoãuãrã ãpãeãoãpãlãeã ãfãrãoãmã ãtãhãeã ãsãaãmãeã ãfãaãtãeã.
	"Our world?" Owyn asked. "The Valheru have been dead on my world for time beyond reckoning. They can't pose any threat to us..."
	A feeling of disinterest washed through him as the god brushed aside the question. ãTãhãeã ãoãnãeã ãyãoãuã ãkãnãoãwã ãaãsã ãPãuãgã ãoãfã ãSãtãaãrãdãoãcãkã ãwãiãlãlã ãtãeãlãlã ãyãoãuã ãmãoãrãeã ãwãhãeãnã ãtãhãeã ãtãiãmãeã ãcãoãmãeãsã ãfãoãrã ãyãoãuã ãaãnãdã ãtãhãeã ãWãaãnãdãeãrãeãrã ãtãoã ãmãaãkãeã ãyãoãuãrã ãcãhãoãiãcãeãsã.ã ãFãoãrã ãnãoãwã,ã ãyãoãuã ãmãuãsãtã ãbãrãiãnãgã ãtãoã ãtãhãiãsã ãpãlãaãcãeã ãtãhãeã ãCãuãpã ãoãfã ãRãlãnãnã ãSãkãrãrã.ã ãDãoã ãtãhãiãsã ãaãnãdã ãwãeã ãwãiãlãlã ãfãrãeãeã ãPãuãgã ãfãrãoãmã ãhãiãsã ãcãaãpãtãiãvãiãtãyã.ã.ã.
	Suddenly suspicious about the nature of the entity which spoke to him, he worded his reply carefully. "If you are a god, why do you need me to fetch a cup for you? And why should I trust a bodiless someone who claims to have imprisoned the one we look for?"
	ãYãoãuã ãaãrãeã ãwãiãsãeã ãtãoã ãqãuãeãsãtãiãoãnã,ã ãtãhãeã ãvãoãiãcãeã ãrãeãpãlãiãeãdã,ã ãbãuãtã ãiãtã ãiãsã ãmãiãnãeã ãaãlãoãnãeã ãtãoã ãkãnãoãwã ãtãhãiãsã ãtãrãuãtãhã.ã ãYãoãuã ãmãaãyã ãdãoã ãaãsã ãIã ãaãsãkã ãaãnãdã ãbãrãiãnãgã ãtãoã ãmãeã ãtãhãeã ãCãuãpã ãoãfã ãRãlãnãnã ãSãkãrãrã ãoãrã ãyãoãuã ãmãaãyã ãpãeãrãiãsãhã ãiãnã ãtãhãeã ãdãeãsãoãlãaãtãiãoãnã ãoãfã ãTãiãmãiãrãiãaãnãyãaã.ã ãTãhãeã ãcãhãoãiãcãeã ãiãsã ãyãoãuãrãsã.ã ãIã ãwãaãrãnã ãyãoãuã ãhãoãwãeãvãeãrã ãiãtã ãwãoãuãlãdã ãbãeã ãaãnã ãuãnãwãiãsãeã ãdãeãcãiãsãiãoãnã ãtãoã ãuãtãiãlãiãzãeã ãiãtãsã ãpãoãwãeãrãsã.ã ãPãuãgã ãaãlãrãeãaãdãyã ãhãaãsã ãlãeãaãrãnãeãdã ãtãhãiãsã ãlãeãsãsãoãnã.ã.ã.�
entries.translation:
@4遲疑了一下。
	在那地獄般酷熱、閃爍著奇異光芒的空氣中，那顆被烈日曬得溫熱的水晶柱，摸上去恐怕會燙傷人，但他還是很好奇，這根玻璃般的石柱究竟是用什麼材質做成的。他心裡暗自納悶，會不會是他們在沙漠平原上遇見過的那些蛇人一族，跟這些謎樣的巨石陣有關，但不知怎地，這個念頭讓他覺得ñ不對勁……
	ã不ã。ã卡ã爾ã贊ã眾ã柱ã，ã從ã來ã就ã並ã非ã由ã潘ã納ã斯ã提ã安ã登ã所ã打ã造ã，ã它ã們ã的ã源ã頭ã另ã有ã所ã自ã，ã遠ã比ã你ã所ã能ã想ã像ã的ã，ã還ã要ã更ã加ã古ã老ã、ã更ã加ã深ã邃ã難ã測ã、ã更ã加ã不ã可ã思ã議ã。，一個聲音在他腦海中低語道。ã是ã我ã們ã，ã親ã手ã、ã親ã自ã塑ã造ã了ã我ã們ã自ã己ã的ã啊ã…ã…
	被這突如其來、未經邀請便闖入腦海的異界存在給嚇得魂飛魄散，@4猛地從石柱旁退開，但那入侵者卻依然留在他的意識之中，揮之不去。ã我ã們ã七ã位ã，ã曾ã經ã是ã提ã米ã里ã安ã雅ã的ã眾ã神ã，ã凡ã人ã啊ã，ã你ã當ã謹ã記ã此ã事ã，ã永ã誌ã不ã忘ã，ã切ã莫ã輕ã忽ã遺ã忘ã了ã此ã事ã，ã聽ã著ã。ã我ã本ã人ã，ã曾ã經ã是ã門ã扉ã之ã主ã，ã達ã沙ã梵ã，ã如ã今ã卻ã已ã不ã再ã是ã了ã，ã往ã昔ã的ã榮ã光ã早ã已ã不ã復ã存ã在ã，ã一ã去ã不ã復ã返ã矣ã。ã可ã是ã自ã從ã瓦ã爾ã赫ã魯ã掀ã起ã了ã他ã們ã那ã場ã荒ã蕪ã毀ã滅ã的ã滔ã天ã戰ã爭ã之ã後ã，ã我ã們ã才ã總ã算ã堪ã堪ã避ã開ã了ã那ã場ã猶ã如ã巨ã星ã殞ã落ã般ã的ã滅ã頂ã之ã死ã，ã堪ã堪ã逃ã過ã那ã一ã劫ã，ã僥ã倖ã存ã活ã了ã下ã來ã，ã得ã以ã苟ã延ã殘ã喘ã至ã今ã，ã未ã曾ã真ã正ã徹ã底ã消ã亡ã殆ã盡ã，ã也ã未ã曾ã全ã數ã死ã絕ã啊ã…ã…
	「我聽不懂你說的這些話到底ó是什麼ð意思，」@4回答道。「我對精靈口中那些被稱為瓦爾赫魯的上古種族略有耳聞，但也僅止於此了……」
	ã此ã事ã並ã不ã重ã要ã，ã凡ã人ã啊ã，ã那ã聲ã音ã緩ã緩ã說ã道ã，ã你ã不ã必ã再ã多ã問ã了ã，ã此ã事ã與ã你ã無ã關ã，ã休ã要ã多ã問ã了ã，ã聽ã著ã就ã好ã。ã我ã們ã曾ã經ã擁ã有ã的ã一ã切ã，ã如ã今ã早ã已ã失ã落ã殆ã盡ã，ã再ã也ã無ã法ã尋ã回ã，ã這ã件ã事ã早ã已ã成ã了ã定ã局ã，ã無ã可ã挽ã回ã。ã但ã要ã拯ã救ã你ã們ã自ã己ã的ã族ã人ã，ã讓ã他ã們ã免ã於ã落ã入ã同ã樣ã的ã命ã運ã，ã此ã刻ã仍ã然ã為ã時ã未ã晚ã，ã依ã舊ã尚ã有ã一ã線ã生ã機ã可ã以ã尋ã覓ã，ã好ã自ã為ã之ã吧ã，ã凡ã人ã啊ã。
	「我們的世界？」歐文問道。「瓦爾赫魯在我們的世界裡，早已死去不知多少個年頭了。他們根本不可能對我們構成什麼威脅……」
	一股興趣索然的感覺湧過他全身，那位神明似乎毫不在意地揮開了這個問題。ã你ã們ã所ã認ã識ã、ã也ã被ã世ã人ã稱ã為ã星ã塢ã島ã之ã帕ã格ã的ã那ã個ã人ã，ã等ã到ã你ã與ã那ã位ã流ã浪ã者ã兩ã人ã必ã須ã做ã出ã抉ã擇ã的ã時ã刻ã終ã於ã來ã臨ã之ã時ã，ã他ã自ã然ã會ã親ã口ã告ã訴ã你ã們ã更ã多ã的ã事ã情ã原ã委ã，ã屆ã時ã一ã切ã自ã然ã會ã漸ã漸ã明ã朗ã清ã晰ã起ã來ã，ã無ã需ã你ã們ã多ã加ã憂ã心ã煩ã惱ã、ã胡ã亂ã揣ã測ã猜ã想ã個ã不ã停ã。ã而ã眼ã下ã此ã刻ã，ã你ã們ã必ã須ã先ã把ã那ã只ã古ã老ã而ã珍ã貴ã無ã比ã的ã倫ã恩ã斯ã克ã爾ã之ã杯ã給ã尋ã找ã出ã來ã，ã親ã自ã帶ã到ã這ã個ã地ã方ã來ã見ã我ã一ã面ã才ã行ã。ã只ã要ã做ã到ã了ã這ã件ã事ã，ã我ã們ã便ã會ã信ã守ã自ã己ã的ã承ã諾ã與ã誓ã言ã，ã將ã帕ã格ã從ã那ã長ã久ã的ã囚ã禁ã之ã中ã徹ã底ã釋ã放ã出ã來ã，ã重ã獲ã自ã由ã之ã身ã，ã重ã見ã天ã日ã，ã得ã享ã自ã在ã逍ã遙ã，ã再ã無ã拘ã束ã，ã永ã遠ã不ã再ã受ã縛ã了ã…ã…
	忽然對這個與他交談的存在的本質心生疑竇，他字斟句酌地謹慎回答道。「如果你真的是神，那為什麼還需要我幫你去取一只杯子？再說了，我又憑什麼要相信一個沒有實體、卻聲稱囚禁了我們正在尋找之人的傢伙呢？」

	感受到體內那股熟悉的存在微微騷動，他耐心等候著，靜候那個存在回應他心中的呼喚。
	ã你ã們ã終ã於ã帶ã著ã這ã只ã聖ã杯ã回ã來ã了ã，ã那ã聲ã音ã平ã靜ã地ã緩ã緩ã說ã道ã，ã語ã氣ã中ã不ã帶ã一ã絲ã一ã毫ã的ã波ã瀾ã起ã伏ã，ã聽ã不ã出ã絲ã毫ã的ã喜ã怒ã哀ã樂ã。ã這ã很ã好ã，ã這ã正ã是ã我ã們ã所ã期ã望ã、ã所ã盼ã望ã已ã久ã的ã圓ã滿ã結ã果ã。ã如ã今ã，ã那ã些ã早ã已ã被ã自ã己ã的ã族ã人ã所ã徹ã底ã遺ã棄ã、ã拋ã下ã不ã管ã的ã潘ã塔ã西ã亞ã人ã後ã裔ã，ã將ã永ã永ã遠ã遠ã被ã拒ã於ã這ã座ã大ã殿ã之ã外ã，ã再ã也ã無ã法ã踏ã入ã這ã片ã神ã聖ã之ã地ã一ã步ã了ã，ã休ã想ã再ã越ã雷ã池ã半ã步ã、ã有ã絲ã毫ã僭ã越ã。ã我ã們ã可ã以ã確ã信ã一ã件ã事ã：ã他ã們ã此ã後ã將ã再ã也ã聽ã不ã見ã、ã也ã再ã也ã感ã應ã不ã到ã自ã己ã那ã位ã米ã德ã肯ã米ã亞ã情ã婦ã的ã任ã何ã指ã示ã與ã呼ã喚ã了ã，ã她ã的ã聲ã音ã對ã他ã們ã而ã言ã，ã將ã永ã遠ã沉ã寂ã下ã去ã，ã再ã無ã回ã音ã，ã形ã同ã死ã寂ã一ã片ã。ã然ã而ã，ã話ã雖ã如ã此ã，ã他ã們ã與ã自ã己ã那ã些ã同ã族ã兄ã弟ã重ã新ã建ã立ã起ã的ã聯ã繫ã，ã卻ã很ã可ã能ã為ã你ã們ã的ã世ã界ã帶ã來ã極ã其ã可ã怕ã、ã極ã其ã深ã遠ã、ã難ã以ã估ã量ã的ã後ã果ã與ã災ã難ã，ã這ã一ã點ã你ã們ã務ã必ã牢ã牢ã謹ã記ã在ã心ã，ã萬ã萬ã不ã可ã掉ã以ã輕ã心ã、ã疏ã忽ã大ã意ã，ã更ã不ã可ã置ã若ã罔ã聞ã才ã是ã。ã但ã眼ã下ã這ã一ã刻ã，ã你ã們ã暫ã且ã還ã不ã必ã為ã此ã事ã過ã度ã憂ã心ã煩ã惱ã、ã輾ã轉ã難ã眠ã。ã這ã只ã聖ã杯ã所ã蘊ã藏ã的ã強ã大ã力ã量ã，ã如ã今ã可ã以ã先ã行ã封ã印ã、ã暫ã時ã壓ã制ã平ã息ã下ã來ã，ã一ã直ã等ã到ã將ã來ã真ã正ã有ã需ã要ã再ã度ã動ã用ã它ã的ã那ã一ã天ã，ã屆ã時ã再ã重ã新ã將ã它ã喚ã醒ã過ã來ã，ã也ã還ã來ã得ã及ã，ã不ã必ã操ã之ã過ã急ã，ã更ã不ã必ã心ã急ã如ã焚ã才ã是ã。

Pug studied the column.
	When he had visited the site at Karzeen previously, he had sensed the sentience that radiated from them, but had been unaware of the true nature of the beings who inhabited them. Stepping forward, he made a slight bow.
	"Greetings, cousins of the Aal," he said. "I regret that I did not recognize you on my first visit. My apologies. It was only during the time I was in the tent that something the Oracle spoke of once occurred to me."

	Pug nodded. "He has been a true friend to me, only as one other has ever been. It is an honor that he prized me so highly. I sometimes wonder that he will ever stop protecting me."

	"I came here in search of my daughter, Gamina. A magician, a ñsavani by your terms, brought her here against her will. It is important that I find her and return to my home to avert a possible catastrophe. Forces are gathering to tamper with the Lifestone."
	For a moment there was silence, the only motion in the air made by the rasp of the sands moving in the deserts. Then, quite abruptly, Dhatsavan's voice returned. ãYãoãuãrã ãdãaãuãgãhãtãeãrã ãiãsã ãcãaãgãeãdã ãbãyã ãPãaãnãaãtãhã-ãTãiãaãnãdãnã.ã ãTãhãeãyã ãbãeãlãiãeãvãeã ãhãeãrã ãaãnã ãoãmãeãnã ãtãhãaãtã ãAãlãmãaã-ãLãoãdãkãaã ãhãaãsã ãhãeãaãrãdã ãtãhãeãiãrã ãpãlãeãaãsã ãaãnãdã ãiãsã ãpãrãeãpãaãrãiãnãgã ãtãhãeã ãwãaãyã ãfãoãrã ãhãeãrã ãrãeãtãuãrãnã.

	ãNão, Dhatsavan replied. ãSãuãcãhã ãaãsã ãmãyã ãpãoãwãeãrãsã ãoãnãcãeã ãwãeãrãeã,ã ãtãhãeãyã ãaãrãeã ãlãiãmãiãtãeãdã,ã ãpãaãrãtã ãoãfã ãtãhãeã ãpãrãiãcãeã ãwãeã ãpãaãiãdã ãfãoãrã ãcãoãnãtãiãnãuãeãdã ãeãxãiãsãtãeãnãcãeã.

帕格仔細端詳著這根石柱。
	當他先前造訪卡爾贊遺址時，就曾感應到從這些石柱中散發出來的靈性，卻始終不清楚棲居其中的到底是什麼樣的存在，其真實本質為何。他向前踏出一步，微微躬身行了個禮。
	「幸會了，阿爾一族的表親們，」他說道。「我很抱歉，第一次造訪時沒能認出你們的身分。萬分抱歉。直到我待在那頂帳篷裡時，神諭曾經提過的某件事，才忽然浮現在我腦海之中。」
	ã對ã我ã們ã這ã些ã自ã居ã為ã凡ã人ã之ã神ã的ã存ã在ã而ã言ã，ã其ã實ã根ã本ã就ã不ã需ã要ã什ã麼ã道ã歉ã之ã詞ã，ã不ã過ã我ã們ã還ã是ã欣ã然ã接ã受ã了ã你ã這ã份ã誠ã摯ã的ã敬ã意ã與ã心ã意ã，ã銘ã記ã在ã心ã永ã不ã敢ã忘ã。ã馬ã克ã羅ã斯ã生ã前ã十ã分ã看ã重ã你ã的ã安ã危ã，ã將ã你ã的ã性ã命ã看ã得ã極ã為ã珍ã貴ã、ã視ã若ã珍ã寶ã，ã絲ã毫ã不ã容ã有ã失ã，ã這ã一ã點ã你ã們ã當ã謹ã記ã在ã心ã。
	帕格點了點頭。「他一直是我真正的摯友，這世上，也只有另一個人曾這樣待我。他如此看重我，實在是我的榮幸。我有時甚至會想，他究竟會不會有停止保護我的一天。」
	ã人ã稱ã帕ã格ã的ã人ã啊ã，ã你ã並ã不ã是ã特ã意ã為ã了ã在ã我ã們ã面ã前ã浪ã費ã時ã間ã、ã道ã謝ã致ã意ã，ã才ã不ã遠ã千ã里ã跋ã涉ã來ã到ã這ã裡ã的ã吧ã，ã我ã猜ã想ã是ã這ã樣ã沒ã錯ã吧ã。ã說ã吧ã，ã坦ã白ã告ã訴ã我ã們ã，ã你ã到ã底ã想ã從ã我ã們ã這ã些ã提ã米ã里ã安ã雅ã的ã眾ã神ã這ã裡ã，ã求ã得ã些ã什ã麼ã樣ã的ã東ã西ã呢ã？ã儘ã管ã開ã口ã說ã來ã，ã不ã必ã猶ã豫ã。
	「我是為了尋找我的女兒，加米娜，而來到這裡的。一位法師，用你們的說法，是一位ñ凡人，違背了她的意願，把她帶到了這裡。我必須找到她，帶她回家，以避免一場可能發生的浩劫。有人正在集結力量，妄圖對生命石動手腳。」
	有那麼一瞬間，四周一片靜默，空氣中唯一的動靜，只有沙漠中細沙摩挲移動的沙沙聲響。接著，達沙梵的聲音忽然又響了起來。ã你ã的ã女ã兒ã，ã如ã今ã被ã潘ã納ã斯ã提ã安ã登ã給ã囚ã禁ã起ã來ã了ã，ã被ã關ã在ã他ã們ã地ã盤ã最ã深ã處ã的ã一ã座ã祕ã密ã密ã室ã之ã中ã，ã日ã日ã夜ã夜ã派ã人ã嚴ã加ã看ã守ã著ã，ã不ã得ã脫ã身ã逃ã離ã半ã步ã。ã他ã們ã深ã信ã不ã疑ã，ã堅ã信ã她ã的ã出ã現ã，ã正ã是ã一ã個ã吉ã祥ã的ã徵ã兆ã，ã象ã徵ã著ã阿ã爾ã瑪ã洛ã達ã卡ã已ã經ã聽ã見ã了ã他ã們ã長ã久ã以ã來ã虔ã誠ã的ã祈ã求ã與ã呼ã喚ã，ã如ã今ã正ã在ã為ã她ã的ã歸ã來ã悄ã悄ã地ã鋪ã路ã了ã，ã指ã日ã可ã待ã矣ã，ã為ã期ã已ã不ã遠ã了ã。
	「她有什麼危險嗎？」帕格問道。「有沒有什麼是你能為她做的？」
	ã並ã不，達沙梵回答道。ã至ã於ã我ã曾ã經ã擁ã有ã的ã那ã些ã力ã量ã，ã如ã今ã早ã已ã變ã得ã十ã分ã有ã限ã了ã，ã這ã正ã是ã我ã們ã為ã了ã延ã續ã自ã身ã的ã存ã在ã，ã所ã必ã須ã付ã出ã的ã那ã部ã分ã沉ã重ã代ã價ã之ã一ã，ã早ã已ã不ã復ã當ã年ã之ã勇ã，ã今ã非ã昔ã比ã矣ã，ã再ã也ã回ã不ã到ã從ã前ã那ã般ã全ã盛ã強ã大ã的ã時ã候ã了ã呀ã，ã一ã去ã不ã復ã返ã矣ã。
	「當年為了驅逐瓦爾赫魯，你們把生命之力結晶化，因而耗盡了自己的精粹本源。等到他們的魔法能力似乎開始衰退之後，他們便以為是已經榨乾了這顆星球的生命之力，這才離開了。」
	ã你ã的ã這ã番ã推ã測ã十ã分ã精ã妙ã、ã鞭ã辟ã入ã裡ã，ã凡ã人ã啊ã，ã猜ã得ã極ã為ã準ã確ã透ã徹ã、ã一ã針ã見ã血ã啊ã。ã但ã提ã米ã里ã安ã雅ã的ã眾ã神ã，ã如ã今ã尚ã未ã真ã正ã徹ã底ã死ã去ã消ã亡ã，ã事ã情ã遠ã遠ã並ã沒ã有ã你ã所ã想ã像ã的ã那ã麼ã簡ã單ã容ã易ã。ã我ã們ã就ã會ã一ã直ã靜ã靜ã地ã在ã此ã原ã地ã耐ã心ã地ã等ã候ã下ã去ã，ã一ã直ã等ã到ã我ã們ã要ã嘛ã徹ã底ã陷ã入ã永ã恆ã漫ã長ã的ã沉ã睡ã之ã中ã、ã要ã嘛ã能ã夠ã透ã過ã這ã些ã浩ã劫ã遺ã留ã下ã來ã的ã孩ã子ã們ã重ã新ã獲ã得ã新ã生ã的ã那ã一ã天ã，ã真ã正ã到ã來ã為ã止ã，ã方ã才ã肯ã真ã正ã罷ã休ã安ã心ã。ã又ã或ã許ã，ã等ã到ã有ã朝ã一ã日ã他ã們ã終ã於ã徹ã底ã忘ã卻ã了ã阿ã爾ã瑪ã洛ã達ã卡ã與ã瓦ã爾ã赫ã魯ã一ã族ã其ã餘ã成ã員ã曾ã經ã存ã在ã過ã的ã這ã件ã事ã之ã後ã，ã便ã能ã以ã他ã們ã自ã己ã獨ã特ã的ã方ã式ã，ã逐ã漸ã成ã熟ã茁ã壯ã、ã獨ã當ã一ã面ã起ã來ã了ã，ã這ã也ã是ã未ã可ã知ã也ã的ã事ã情ã。ã一ã切ã都ã得ã端ã看ã造ã化ã的ã巧ã妙ã安ã排ã了ã，ã就ã連ã我ã們ã自ã己ã也ã無ã從ã得ã知ã確ã切ã的ã答ã案ã究ã竟ã為ã何ã，ã天ã機ã難ã測ã、ã玄ã妙ã莫ã名ã，ã實ã非ã我ã等ã凡ã俗ã所ã能ã盡ã知ã也ã。
	帕格平靜地接受了這番說法，正打算轉身離去，卻又忽然停下了腳步。「馬卡拉有沒有在她身邊布下什麼特別的咒法？我眼下的能力實在十分有限……」
	ã去ã尋ã找ã瓦ã爾ã赫ã魯ã一ã族ã那ã些ã古ã老ã部ã眾ã遺ã留ã下ã來ã的ã殘ã跡ã遺ã物ã吧ã。ã那ã裡ã頭ã，ã或ã許ã還ã留ã有ã什ã麼ã有ã用ã的ã東ã西ã，ã能ã夠ã幫ã得ã上ã你ã的ã忙ã、ã對ã你ã有ã所ã助ã益ã也ã說ã不ã定ã，ã不ã妨ã親ã自ã前ã去ã試ã一ã試ã探ã看ã究ã竟ã如ã何ã。ã再ã會ã了ã，ã帕ã格ã。ã達ã沙ã梵ã此ã後ã便ã不ã會ã再ã多ã說ã些ã什ã麼ã了ã，ã就ã此ã別ã過ã，ã後ã會ã有ã期ã，ã望ã你ã此ã去ã一ã路ã多ã加ã珍ã重ã保ã重ã。�

	一個矮小的男人推開了那扇編織方式古怪的帳篷門簾，走上前來，瞇著眼打量著他們。他的舉止大致上並不起眼，只是隨意地走上前來，彷彿在這片詭異的沙漠世界中遇見人類，根本不是什麼出乎意料的事……�

entries.source: "Where is Tomas? It is important I speak with him."�
entries.translation: 「托馬斯在哪裡？我有要事必須跟他談談。」�

entries.source: "He was unable to come and he sent us after you. He gave us the spell which you left to him..."�
entries.translation: 「他沒辦法過來，所以派我們來找你。他把你留給他的那道法術交給了我們……」�

entries.source: "Unable to come? Why? What has happened to him?"�
entries.translation: 「沒辦法過來？為什麼？他到底出了什麼事？」�

entries.source: "He was injured during an attack on Elvandar by the moredhel. Queen Aglaranna assures us that he will be all right..."�
entries.translation: 「他在摩瑞德爾人攻擊艾爾凡達時受了傷。阿格拉蘭娜女王向我們保證，他會沒事的……」�

entries.source: "I can't believe that Makala's plans would be served by sending you here, so for the moment I will have to trust your word... In looking at you, it occurs to me your face is ófamiliar. Are you the magician boy who came into Krondor with Seigneur Locklear a few months ago?"�
entries.translation: 「我實在難以相信，派你們來這裡會對馬卡拉的計畫有什麼幫助，所以眼下我只能暫且相信你們的話……看著你，我忽然覺得你這張臉似乎ó有些眼熟。你是不是幾個月前，跟洛克利爾爵士一起來到肯多的那個小法師？」�

entries.source: "Yes, and you remember Gorath?"�
entries.translation: 「沒錯，你還記得戈拉斯嗎？」�

entries.source: "His face has been hard for me to óforget these last few nights. He was the first tool of Makala's in this grand scheme..."�
entries.translation: 「這幾個晚上，我實在很難ó忘記他那張臉。他是馬卡拉這整盤大局裡，第一個被利用的棋子……」�

entries.source: "You accuse us of being liars and spies?"�
entries.translation: 「你這是在指控我們是騙子和間諜嗎？」�

entries.source:
"I'm not implicating you were a ówilling participant, Gorath. You were as unknowing in your part as I must assume Delekhan is in his. When you said he had raised the war banners of Murmandamus over Sar-Sargoth, I became somewhat alarmed."
	"Having seen Murmandamus' death with my own eyes, I had no reason to believe he still lived, but forces acting in his name caused the calamity at Sethanon and I thought it possible the Pantathians were once again responsible. After some investigation I found they were óindeed interfering with affairs in the Kingdom, but were acting through a band of magical thieves searching for various magical items---trinkets---in no way directly responsible for what was happening in the Northlands or posing immediate threat to Midkemia.
	With the issue resolved, I believed then Delekhan was merely exploiting the reputation of his predecessor to gain power..."�
entries.translation:
「戈拉斯，我並不是指控你是ó心甘情願的參與者。你對自己所扮演的角色一無所知，就跟我猜想戴勒肯對他自己的角色一樣毫不知情。當你說他在薩薩戈斯高舉起穆爾曼達莫斯的戰旗時，我確實有些警覺了起來。」
	「我曾親眼目睹穆爾曼達莫斯死去，沒有理由相信他還活著，但打著他名號行事的勢力，卻在塞薩儂引發了那場浩劫，我當時猜想，這或許又是潘納斯提安族在背後搞的鬼。經過一番調查後，我發現他們ó確實插手了王國的事務，但實際上是透過一群搜尋各種魔法物品——那些小玩意兒——的魔法竊賊在行動，這跟北方大陸發生的事，或是米德凱米亞眼下面臨的立即威脅，都沒有直接關係。」
	「這件事解決之後，我原本以為，戴勒肯只是想利用他前任的名聲來奪權而已……」�

entries.source: "So then what did Gorath tell you that was so important?"�
entries.translation: 「那麼，戈拉斯到底跟你說了什麼那麼重要的事？」�

entries.source:
"It was only after Makala tricked me into coming here that Gorath's testimony to Prince Arutha took on any significance. In passing, he had mentioned Delekhan wearing a helm of black, shaped like a dragon. Murmandamus wore such a helm and had it with him when Prince Arutha cut him down...Whoever had given Delekhan Murmandamus' helm had to have had been óinside the caverns beneath Sethanon."
	"There are only four magicians I can think of who might have had the wiles to slip inside the first perimeter of defenses that have been placed there. One is Macros, but since he was instrumental in averting catastrophe there, I cannot believe he would be responsible. Another is a magician whom Macros once told me of, named Nakor the Isalani; but again, I have reason to believe the Northlands would hold little interest for him. The only others who would be capable are Elghar and Makala, but Elghar has been quite busy with his students at Stardock..."�
entries.translation:
「直到馬卡拉騙我來到這裡之後，戈拉斯向亞魯薩親王作的證詞，才顯得意義重大起來。他曾隨口提過，戴勒肯戴著一頂黑色的頭盔，形狀像條龍。穆爾曼達莫斯就曾戴過這樣一頂頭盔，而且在亞魯薩親王將他斬殺時，那頂頭盔就在他身上……不管是誰把穆爾曼達莫斯的頭盔交給戴勒肯，那個人一定曾經ó深入過塞薩儂地底的那些洞穴才行。」
	「我能想到的，只有四位法師有這樣的手段，能夠潛入那裡設下的第一層防禦圈。其中一位是馬克羅斯，但既然他當初在那裡對阻止那場浩劫出了不少力，我實在難以相信他會是幕後主使。另一位，是馬克羅斯曾經跟我提過的一位法師，名叫伊薩蘭尼的納科爾；不過我同樣有理由相信，北方大陸對他來說興趣缺缺。剩下有能力辦到這件事的，就只有艾爾加和馬卡拉了，但艾爾加最近一直忙著在星塢照顧他的學生們……」�

entries.source: "Leaving your only suspect as Makala. But why is he doing all of this? Why would he be pushing Delekhan into a war with the Kingdom?"�
entries.translation: 「這樣一來，你唯一的嫌疑對象就只剩下馬卡拉了。但他為什麼要做這一切呢？他為什麼要把戴勒肯推向跟王國開戰的局面？」�

entries.source: "If he ówas ingenious enough to get within the caverns, he would still need considerable help achieving his final objective---a chamber containing an artifact of unbelievable destructive power about which he has been indefatigably interested. I left behind a dragon to guard it, and even ómy powers would be sorely taxed in a single battle against a dragon her age, let alone one with the special capabilities of the one who sleeps under Sethanon. Once she is alarmed, she will no doubt summon help from a secret garrison of soldiers which King Lyam ordered to remain in the region of Sethanon, soldiers whom Makala surely would have detected on his first visit and intends to counter with Delekhan's moredhel troops..."�
entries.translation: 「就算他ó真有那個本事潛入那些洞穴，要達成他最終的目標——那間藏有一件威力驚人到令人難以置信的毀滅性神器的密室——他仍然需要相當程度的幫助才行，他對那件神器的執著，可是從未有一刻鬆懈過。我留下了一條龍在那裡守護著它，就連ó我自己的力量，光是跟一條那個年紀的龍正面交手一次，都得吃盡苦頭了，更別說是那條沉睡在塞薩儂地底、擁有特殊能力的龍了。一旦她察覺到異狀，她必定會召喚萊姆國王下令留守在塞薩儂周邊地區的那支祕密駐軍前來相助，而馬卡拉在第一次造訪時，肯定早就察覺到這支駐軍的存在，並打算用戴勒肯麾下的摩瑞德爾大軍來加以牽制……」�

entries.source: "But that's why Prince Arutha sent us to find you! He's afraid that Delekhan is going to have magicians working at the siege at Northwarden! Maybe if we can stop them there..."�
entries.translation: 「但這正是亞魯薩親王派我們來找你的原因啊！他擔心戴勒肯會讓法師在北衛堡的圍城戰中出手！也許只要我們能在那裡阻止他們……」�

entries.source: "Unfortunately, I'm of no use to anyone at the moment, let alone Prince Arutha. In my blind haste to find Gamina, I used a magical artifact that would have best been left alone..."�
entries.translation: 「很遺憾，我現在對任何人都幫不上什麼忙，更別說是亞魯薩親王了。為了盡快找到加米娜，我在盲目匆忙之下，動用了一件本該置之不理的魔法神器……」�

entries.source: "We already know something about it. You said before that you were going to have to trust us, so you'll have to trust me now when I tell you I think I can help. I hope for all our sakes that I'm not wrong about this..."�
entries.translation: 「這件事，我們多少已經知道一些了。你之前說過，你不得不相信我們，所以現在換我告訴你，我想我能幫得上忙，你也得相信我才行。看在我們大家的份上，我真心希望自己這次沒有想錯……」�

帕格顫抖著舉起那只鑲滿寶石的倫恩斯克爾之杯，感覺到一股力量在這件鑲滿寶石的神器之中迸發流竄。他的意識如漣漪般不斷向外擴散，觸及了同行夥伴們的心靈，感受到了敬畏、困惑、恐懼、痛楚，以及ñ知識ð……
	毫無預警之間，歐文的心靈與帕格的心靈猛然相連，兩人都被這股親密無間的接觸震懾得暈頭轉向。á把á你á所á知á道á的á那á一á切á法á術á與á各á種á奧á術á方á面á的á所á有á知á識á，á統á統á都á要á好á好á地á集á中á精á神á，á仔á細á專á注á起á來á。 帕格在心中想著。á我á也á會á做á同á樣á的á事á，á儘á管á我á現á在á身á體á十á分á虛á弱á、á狀á態á不á佳á，á元á氣á大á傷á，á但á我á想á，á畢á竟á我á在á這á方á面á，á也á曾á經á下á過á一á番á苦á功á，á用á心á鑽á研á過á，á比á起á你á來á說á，á我á從á這á當á中á所á能á得á到á的á助á益á，á恐á怕á還á會á更á多á一á些á才á對á，á這á點á我á心á裡á也á十á分á清á楚á，á毫á不á懷á疑á。�

entries.source:
Owyn stirred and found that Gorath was standing over him, a look of concern on his face. "I was wondering about you two," he said.
	"How long was...were ñwe out?" Owyn asked, sitting upright.
	"Two days," Gorath replied, smiling at Owyn's startled reaction. "It is a good thing you both had presence enough of mind to eat when I put the food into your hands."�
entries.translation:
歐文動了動身子，發現戈拉斯正站在他身旁，臉上帶著一絲擔憂的神情。「我還在納悶你們兩個怎麼樣了，」他說道。
	「我們昏迷了……ñ多久了？」歐文一邊問道，一邊坐直了身子。
	「兩天了，」戈拉斯回答道，看著歐文驚訝的反應，微微一笑。「幸好你們兩個當時還算清醒，我把食物遞到你們手中時，你們都還記得吃下去。」�

entries.source:
@4 waited.
	When at last it became clear that the entity within was beyond reaching, he removed his hand from the crystalline pillar. "Gone," @4 said. "Either it's sleeping or it's died. I can't tell which."�
entries.translation:
@4 靜靜等候著。
	等到終於確定裡頭的那個存在已經無法再回應了，他才把手從那根水晶石柱上收了回來。「消失了，」@4 說道。「不知道是睡著了，還是已經死了，我實在分辨不出來。」�

entries.source:
The pillar was smooth to his touch.
	Towering over @3, it seemed to be made of an exquisite crystal of some fashion, though it was wholly unlike anything he had ever seen on Midkemia. Through it he could see refracted images of the desert beyond, but when he varied the angle at which he held his head, it seemed as though he could see other places which were ónot on the other side of the column. Instead, it seemed that there were images of oceans and skies of other colors...
	ãYãoãuãrã ãoãbãsãeãrãvãaãtãiãoãnãsã ãiãnãtãrãiãgãuãeã ãmãeã.ã ãYãoãuã ãaãrãeã ãsãaãvãaãnãiã,ã ãaãrãeã ãyãoãuã ãnãoãtã?
	Startled at the presence of the alien sentience in his mind, @3 shook his head. Unsure whether he should simply think his reply or speak it aloud, he decided that speaking it would be the safest route. "I'm not familiar with the term ósavani so I don't know if I am one or not. Who am I communicating with?"
	Nearby, @5 threw @3 a startled glance, apparently alarmed that his friend was speaking to the air. Before @3 could rattle off an explanation, the voice within his mind returned. ãIã ãaãmã ãSãuãtãaãkãaãmãiã,ã ãMãoãtãhãeãrã ãoãfã ãtãhãeã ãTãhãoãuãsãaãnãdã ãMãyãsãtãeãrãiãeãsã,ã ãoãnãcãeã ãgãoãdãdãeãsãsã ãoãfã ãTãiãmãiãrãiãaãnãyãaã.ã ãYãoãuã ãhãaãvãeã ãsãuãmãmãoãnãeãdã ãmãeã.ã ãWãhãaãtã ãdãoã ãyãoãuã ãdãeãsãiãrãeã ãtãoã ãkãnãoãwã?

	Suddenly @3's mind reeled with visions of men with scales rather than skin and large hulking creatures with shining carapaces which roamed the deserts. Grasping to retain what he learned about the creatures as the information flooded through his mind like a tide, he at last seized upon an image of a wispy figure.
	"What are these things I see?" @3 asked. "They look as if they are made of smoke."

For a moment the image wavered, then stabilized once more. ãIã ãmãuãsãtã ãrãeãsãtã.ã.ã.ãIã ãaãmã ãnãeãeãdãeãdã.ã.ã.ãeãlãsãeãwãhãeãrãeã.ã.ã.�
entries.translation:
石柱觸摸起來十分光滑。
	這根石柱聳立在@3面前，看起來似乎是由某種極為精緻的水晶所打造而成，只是這種水晶，跟他在米德凱米亞見過的任何東西都截然不同。透過它，他能看見遠處沙漠折射出來的種種景象，但當他微微轉動頭部、變換視角時，卻似乎能看見另一些ó並不在石柱另一側的地方。相反地，他看見的，彷彿是其他色彩的海洋與天空的景象……
	ã凡ã人ã啊ã，ã你ã方ã才ã所ã說ã的ã這ã些ã觀ã察ã與ã見ã解ã，ã倒ã是ã引ã起ã了ã我ã幾ã分ã興ã致ã與ã好ã奇ã之ã心ã呢ã。ã你ã，ã應ã當ã就ã是ã薩ã瓦ã尼ã吧ã，ã我ã這ã麼ã猜ã想ã的ã，ã應ã該ã沒ã錯ã吧ã？
	@3的心中，忽然感受到這股異界心靈的存在，嚇得他猛然搖了搖頭。他一時拿不定主意，究竟該只是在心中默想回應，還是該開口說出聲來，最後他認定，開口說出聲來才是最保險的做法。「我對ó薩瓦尼這個詞並不熟悉，所以我也不清楚自己算不算是。我現在究竟是在跟誰交談呢？」

	「我不太確定你在問什麼，」歐文說道。「你是一位神諭嗎？」

Energy blasted from the column.
	Dazed, @3 picked himself up from where he had fallen in the sand, reaching for a hand up from Gorath. "There was this...ópresenceð...that was in the column. When I touched it I felt as if I would kill every single Panath Tiandn on the face of this world...as if I ócould have strangled them all barehanded, and then the feeling was gone."
	"It is strange you should mention it, but I am feeling suddenly vigorous myself. But what are these Panath Tiandn?" @5 replied. "It is an unfamiliar term."
	"The snake men that we've run into. I'm not sure why I know that, but I know that is what they are called on this world."�

	「你會這麼說還真是奇怪，因為我自己也忽然覺得渾身是勁。不過，這些潘納斯提安登到底是什麼？」@5回應道。「這個詞我完全沒聽過。」
	「就是我們遇到的那些蛇人。我也不知道自己為什麼會知道這件事，但我就是知道，在這個世界上，他們就是被這樣稱呼的。」�

entries.source:
There was something odd about the column.
	Removing his hand, @4 struggled to find words for what he was feeling. "You know how it is when someone is standing behind you, and you know that they are standing there, even though you haven't heard them come up?"
	Smiling faintly, Gorath shrugged. "It is a sensation I have heard of, but I am afraid that is an experience almost unknown with my kin." Reaching up, he tugged one of his ears. "There is little that escapes our hearing."
	"Oh." Looking down at the ground, Owyn suddenly flushed, realizing how little he truly knew about Gorath or his people. One day he would make a point of getting to know him better. "Well, I don't know how to explain what I felt in the pillar except that it felt alive. Like there was a presence within it, if only I knew how to reach it."�

這根石柱有些不太對勁。
	@4收回了手，努力想要找出恰當的字眼，來形容自己的感受。「你知道那種感覺嗎？就是有人站在你背後，你明明沒聽見他們靠近的聲音，卻還是能感覺到他們就站在那裡的那種感覺？」
	戈拉斯微微一笑，聳了聳肩。「這種感覺我倒是聽說過，不過恐怕在我們族人之中，這幾乎是聞所未聞的體驗。」他伸手扯了扯自己的一隻耳朵。「幾乎沒什麼事，能逃得過我們的聽覺。」
	「喔。」歐文低頭看著地面，忽然臉紅了起來，這才意識到自己對戈拉斯和他的族人，其實了解得少之又少。總有一天，他一定要好好認識他一下才行。「呃，我也不知道該怎麼形容我在石柱裡感受到的東西，只能說，它感覺像是活的一樣。彷彿裡頭有種什麼樣的存在，只是我還不知道該怎麼跟它接觸罷了。」�

這根石柱是由水晶打造而成的。
	相較於這圈石柱裡的其他幾根，它的狀況要好上許多，反射光滑的表面，也不像其他石柱那樣，被風沙侵蝕得坑坑洞洞的。@4輕輕撫摸著它的表面，不禁對工匠們所投注的心血與工夫，感到嘖嘖稱奇。
